notes: Read all 303 source lines (numbered) before editing. The module is a non-visual, framework-agnostic LRU of recently-visited routes: pure classify/record/read/clear/subscribe helpers persisted in browser localStorage with a synthetic same-tab change event plus the native cross-tab 'storage' event. No JSX, no Recharts/Leaflet, no web UI components — the only browser-coupled pieces are localStorage and the window event bus, each ported behind the established native-parity globalThis-probe precedent (notificationSound / errorClassification).

L1-20 module JSDoc (recently viewed pages; three surfaces — command-palette Recent, dashboard widget, Settings>Privacy clear button; client-side-only privacy rationale; framework-agnostic pure helpers; App.tsx wire-up) ported verbatim, with one added 'Native parity' paragraph pointing at the file header + nativeRecentPagesCapabilities. A leading // file header additionally documents the two browser-only substitutions (localStorage probe, event-bus probe) and the inlined ROUTE_REGISTRY.

L22 `import { ROUTE_REGISTRY } from './routeRegistry'` -> inlined. routeRegistry.ts is NOT yet ported into the native web-parity tree (grep for routeRegistry/ROUTE_REGISTRY across apps/native returned no matches), so — exactly like errorClassification.ts inlines its ./resilience guards 'to keep this port self-contained and typecheck-clean' — the 113 path+label pairs resolvePageLabel reads are inlined verbatim as a local `ROUTE_REGISTRY: readonly RouteLabelEntry[]` (RouteLabelEntry = {path,label}; only those two columns are consumed, the full RouteEntry name/i18nKey/hidden shape stays in the not-yet-ported module). Every web routeRegistry row (/, /admin/feedback ... /year-review/:year) is reproduced byte-for-byte so label resolution is identical.

L24-30 STORAGE_KEY='teslasync:recent-pages:v1', LOCAL_EVENT='teslasync:recent-pages-local-changed', MAX_ENTRIES=50 constants + their comments preserved exactly. LOCAL_EVENT is module-internal (never exported) so substituting its delivery mechanism on pure native is unobservable to consumers.
L32-33 exported RECENT_PAGES_STORAGE_KEY = STORAGE_KEY and RECENT_PAGES_MAX = MAX_ENTRIES ported verbatim.
L35-61 RecentPageKind union (page|vehicle|drive|trip|charging|geofence|year-review) and RecentEntry interface (path, title, kind, ref_id?, visited_at) with all field JSDoc ported verbatim.

L63-89 PATH_PATTERNS table (6 specific-first regexes -> kind), PathClassification interface, and classifyPath (exec each pattern, return {kind, ref_id: m[1]} on first hit else {kind:'page'}) ported verbatim incl. the registry-independence comment.

L91-116 SKIP_PREFIXES (['/onboarding','/s/','/watch']), SKIP_EXACT (Set{'/search','/me/activity'}), and shouldRecordPath ported verbatim: non-string -> false; empty/non-'/'-leading -> false; SKIP_EXACT hit -> false; the trailing-slash prefix branch (path===pre.slice(0,-1) || startsWith(pre)) vs the non-slash branch (path===pre || startsWith(pre+'/')); else true. Privacy/transient-route rationale comment kept.

L118-123 hasStorage(): the web `typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.localStorage !== 'undefined'` guard is replaced by `getWebStorage() !== undefined` (added WebStorageLike interface {getItem,setItem,removeItem} + a globalThis.localStorage probe requiring all three methods — the notificationSound precedent, extended with removeItem which this module needs). Same semantics; hasStorage name preserved and still used by __resetRecentPagesForTests.
L125-135 isValidEntry type guard (object with string path, string title, finite-number visited_at, string kind — kind intentionally not constrained for forward-compat) ported verbatim.

L137-158 load(): the web `if (!hasStorage()) return []` + `window.localStorage.getItem` is ported as `const store = getWebStorage(); if (!store) return []` then `store.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)`. Identical body: getItem-throw -> []; missing/empty raw -> []; non-array parse -> []; push valid items, break once length>=MAX_ENTRIES; parse-throw -> []. On a pure native runtime the store is absent, mirroring the web non-browser path (returns []).

L160-170 save(): web `if (!hasStorage()) return` + `window.localStorage.setItem` ported as `const store = getWebStorage(); if (!store) return` then `store.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(entries))`; setItem-throw -> silent return (quota/disabled-storage comment kept); notify() only on success — all preserved exactly.

L172-180 notify(): the web `window.dispatchEvent(new Event(LOCAL_EVENT))` (guarded by typeof window / typeof window.dispatchEvent) is ported via getEventTarget()+getEventCtor() globalThis probes. When both resolve (react-native-web) it dispatches `new EventCtor(LOCAL_EVENT)` on the target inside the same try/catch (Event-constructor-missing comment kept) — byte-identical to web. When they do NOT resolve (pure native) it instead iterates the module `localListeners` set with per-callback try/catch, providing the same same-process fan-out the web LOCAL_EVENT bus provides. Branches are mutually exclusive on a deterministic runtime so there is no double-fire.

Added native-safe event types/probes (RecentPagesStorageEventLike{key:string|null}, RecentPagesEventTargetLike{addEventListener/removeEventListener/dispatchEvent}, RecentPagesEventCtor, getEventTarget, getEventCtor, localListeners Set) — the notificationSound getStorageEventTarget precedent, extended with dispatchEvent + an Event-ctor probe because this module dispatches a synthetic same-tab event (notificationSound only listened).

L182-219 RecordPageViewInput interface (path,title,kind?,ref_id?,now? test seam) + recordPageView ported verbatim: input?.path guard via shouldRecordPath; classifyPath; visited_at = finite input.now else Date.now(); title = trimmed input.title || path; entry built with kind/ref_id overrides via ??; load().filter(e=>e.path!==path); unshift; truncate to MAX_ENTRIES via length assignment; save. (prettier wrapped the visited_at ternary and dropped the single-arg arrow parens per the repo .prettierrc arrowParens:'avoid'.)
L221-228 getRecentPages(limit?) ported verbatim — slice(0, max(0,limit)) when limit is a number, else the full list.

L230-242 clearRecentPages(): web `if (!hasStorage()) { notify(); return }` + `window.localStorage.removeItem` ported as a single getWebStorage() probe (`const store = getWebStorage(); if (!store) { notify(); return }` then `store.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)` in try/catch) — the no-store path still fires notify() so subscribers refresh, and the success path removes then notifies, exactly as web. ignore-comment kept.

L244-272 subscribeRecentPages(): web `if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {}` then addEventListener(LOCAL_EVENT,onLocal)+addEventListener('storage',onStorage) with the `e.key !== null && e.key !== STORAGE_KEY` guard. Ported via getEventTarget(): when a target exists (react-native-web) both listeners are attached verbatim (onLocal swallow-guarded, onStorage same key guard + handler) and the unsubscribe removes both — identical to web. When no target exists (pure native) the handler is added to `localListeners` and the unsubscribe deletes it, so same-process subscription works (web returned a no-op there); cross-tab 'storage' fan-out is then unavailable. JSDoc kept + a 'Native parity' paragraph added.

L274-293 resolvePageLabel() ported verbatim against the inlined ROUTE_REGISTRY: empty path -> null; first pass exact `r.path === path`; second pass for ':'-containing patterns builds the same escaped regex ('^' + path.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&').replace(/:[^/]+/g,'[^/]+') + '$') and returns r.label on test match; else null. Regex byte-identical (prettier only re-wrapped the concatenation across lines).

L295-303 __resetRecentPagesForTests(): web `if (!hasStorage()) return` + `window.localStorage.removeItem` ported as the same hasStorage() gate then `getWebStorage()?.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)` in try/catch, NO notify() (matches web — the test-only silent wipe). ignore-comment kept.

Additive native-only export `nativeRecentPagesCapabilities` ({durableHistoryPersistenceAvailable:false, crossTabStorageEventAvailable:false} as const) documents the explicit native-unavailable state per the conversion contract, mirroring nativeNotificationSoundCapabilities; react-native-web may still light the real APIs up at runtime via the probes.
No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router-dom, or web UI components imported; the module has zero runtime imports (pure TS + globalThis probes) and runs identically under Hermes.
